newsitem.title: USA: Philips unit "disappointed" by Qualcomm filing.
newsitem.headline: Philips unit "disappointed" by Qualcomm filing.

text.p: Philips Consumer Communications said Thursday it was surprised and disappointed after learning of a complaint filed by Qualcomm Inc seeking to invalidate some Philips patents.

"We are extremely disappointed with the actions, as we have been attempting to negotiate in good faith a cross-licensing agreement with Qualcomm for some time," said Osmo Hautanen, president of Philips Consumer Communications, a U.S. division of Philips Electronics NV.
"Philips, of course, will vigorously defend the validity of its patents," he added.

In the complaint, filed in U.S. District court in San Diego, Qualcomm is seeking a judgment that it does not infringe three Philips patents. The company also argues the patents, which relate to CDMA telecommunications technology, are invalid.
